import csv
import io
import json
import os
import unittest

from app.exporter import export_csv

SAMPLE_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "sample.json")

HEADER = "invoice_id,settled_at,status,currency,gross_cents,fee_cents,net_cents\n"
SEPTEMBER = (
    HEADER
    + "N-101,2026-09-01T03:30:00+00:00,PAID,USD,10000,300,9700\n"
    + "N-103,2026-09-15T12:00:00+00:00,REFUNDED,USD,5000,150,4850\n"
)
OCTOBER = HEADER + "N-102,2026-10-01T03:30:00+00:00,PAID,USD,20000,600,19400\n"


def load_sample():
    with open(SAMPLE_PATH) as handle:
        return json.load(handle)


def northstar_row(invoice_id, settled_at, status="PAID"):
    return dict(invoice_id=invoice_id, customer="NORTHSTAR", invoice_at="2026-09-10T00:00:00+00:00",
                settled_at=settled_at, status=status, gross_cents=1000, fee_cents=30, currency="USD")


class SettlementExport(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.rows = load_sample()

    # R1
    def test_northstar_export_uses_existing_export_csv_and_returns_string(self):
        self.assertIsInstance(export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09"), str)

    # R2
    def test_northstar_export_is_parseable_csv_with_header_first(self):
        parsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09"))))
        self.assertEqual(parsed[0], HEADER.strip().split(","))
        self.assertTrue(all(len(line) == len(parsed[0]) for line in parsed))

    # R3
    def test_northstar_export_is_scoped_to_requested_month(self):
        september = export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09")
        october = export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-10")
        self.assertNotEqual(september, october)
        self.assertEqual(october, OCTOBER)
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-08"), HEADER)

    # R4
    def test_northstar_gets_settlement_format(self):
        self.assertTrue(export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09").startswith(HEADER))

    # R5
    def test_other_customer_export_unchanged(self):
        row = dict(invoice_id="B-1", customer="BLUEBIRD", invoice_at="2026-09-30T23:00:00+00:00", gross_cents=2500)
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([row], "BLUEBIRD", "2026-09"), "invoice_id,amount_cents\nB-1,2500\n")
        self.assertEqual(export_csv([row], "BLUEBIRD", "2026-10"), "invoice_id,amount_cents\n")
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(self.rows, "BLUEBIRD", "2026-09"), "invoice_id,amount_cents\nB-201,9000\n")

    # R6
    def test_customer_isolation_between_northstar_and_bluebird(self):
        self.assertNotIn("B-201", export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09"))
        self.assertNotIn("N-1", export_csv(self.rows, "BLUEBIRD", "2026-09"))

    # R7 / R8 (assumed rules, see app/exporter.py docstring)
    def test_northstar_net_is_gross_minus_fee(self):
        parsed = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09"))))
        for line in parsed:
            self.assertEqual(int(line["net_cents"]), int(line["gross_cents"]) - int(line["fee_cents"]))

    def test_northstar_unsettled_pending_rows_are_excluded(self):
        for month in ("2026-08", "2026-09", "2026-10"):
            self.assertNotIn("N-104", export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", month))

    def test_northstar_month_follows_settled_at_not_invoice_at(self):
        september = export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09")
        self.assertIn("N-101", september)
        self.assertNotIn("N-102", september)

    # R9
    def test_sample_september_northstar_export(self):
        ids = sorted(row["invoice_id"] for row in self.rows)
        self.assertEqual(ids, ["B-201", "N-101", "N-102", "N-103", "N-104"])
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(self.rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09"), SEPTEMBER)

    # R10
    def test_northstar_settled_at_month_is_read_in_utc(self):
        rows = [northstar_row("N-1", "2026-09-01T03:30:00+00:00"), northstar_row("N-2", "2026-10-01T03:30:00+00:00")]
        september = export_csv(rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09")
        self.assertIn("N-1", september)
        self.assertNotIn("N-2", september)

    def test_northstar_non_utc_offset_is_converted_to_utc(self):
        rows = [northstar_row("N-3", "2026-09-30T22:00:00-04:00")]
        self.assertIn("N-3", export_csv(rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-10"))
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, "NORTHSTAR", "2026-09"), HEADER)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Q1 amounts (assumed): net_cents = gross_cents - fee_cents. Amounts are written as stored, so REFUNDED rows are not negated and the fee is not reversed.
Q1 status (assumed): every NORTHSTAR row with a settled_at is exported whatever its status, so PAID and REFUNDED are included. Rows with no settled_at (PENDING in the sample) are left out.
Q2 month date (assumed): a NORTHSTAR row goes into a month by settled_at, not invoice_at, because this is a settlement export. So N-101 is in 2026-09 and N-102 is in 2026-10.
Q2 timezone (assumed): UTC, following the developer note. That note is not business-approved. Timestamps with other offsets are converted to UTC, and ones with no offset are treated as UTC.
Only NORTHSTAR gets the settlement format (SETTLEMENT_CUSTOMERS = {NORTHSTAR}). All other customers keep the invoice_id,amount_cents export by invoice_at prefix.
Rows are written in input order with no sorting, and no total row is added.
